plugin.description: Persistent corpses, camera distance and map borders without ExileCenter. Reversible Steam/Epic and standalone file patches; apply and restore with the game closed.
help: Apply selected visual options to PoE 2 files. They take effect on the next game launch, even without opening ExileCenter. Supports Steam/Epic and the standalone Content.ggpk.
scope: Permanent file patches stay active with ExileCenter closed, until restoration or a game update. To change an applied patch, restore it first, then apply the selected options with the game closed.
capture_camera: Use the last distance measured by CameraZoom
camera_help: This is the starting distance, applied when the character is positioned. Scripted cameras remain unchanged. To save a distance used with the mouse wheel, close ExileCenter normally first, then reopen it and use the measured distance.
camera_missing: No measured distance between 50% and 300% is available. Choose the distance with the slider.
camera_saved: Measured distance selected. Close the game, restore any previous patch, then apply the selected permanent options.
map: Show all map borders without revealing exploration
map_help: Only the map rendering is changed. Exploration, fog visibility, Atlas and map icons are preserved. The game's map transparency setting also applies.
native_help: Select a compatible oo2core.dll. The plugin reuses its own verified cached library when available. No third-party executable is read or launched.
close_game: PoE is open. Close the game to apply or restore this patch. There is no instant in-game toggle.
backup: The original archive is kept in .ExileCenterCadavres inside the game folder. Standalone installations need enough free space for a full copy of Content.ggpk. Restoration is refused if a game update or another tool has changed the patched archive.
